title: cymbopogon collinus
intro: Cymbopogon collinus, commonly known as the Sand Grass or Indian Staff Grass, is a type of perennial grass native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Cymbopogon collinus include its ability to reduce anxiety, improve digestion, and soothe skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
